description:
Trainlax is an exciting game with unique puzzles that will keep you engaged for hours.  
Play the best logic game!  

This game helps you relieve stress and anxiety. If you're looking for a game to improve concentration, Trainlax is the perfect choice. By building railway tracks, you not only relax but also enhance your creativity and critical thinking. It's an ideal pick when you're feeling down or just need to pass the time.  

Simple Gameplay  
Connect the tracks across different landscapes and help the train reach its destination. Solve over 120 puzzles!  

Beautiful Visuals  
With its simplicity and immersive atmosphere, you’ll explore a variety of landscapes—from lush forests to scorching deserts.  
Trainlax is like yoga: the gameplay will relax and calm you!
name: Trainlax: Railway Puzzle Simulator
